title: Patient-Confirmed Cancellation of Outpatient and Home-Care Referrals and Authorizations
content:
When the patient, or the parent or guardian of a minor patient, confirms the cancellation of an approved authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations** counted in visits, hours or rental months, it is closed as cancelled that day and the units left on it are released.

The units a cancellation releases are figured only after any reconsideration of the authorization's denial that was decided overturned or partially overturned shows as a grant on an appeal overturn in the authorization's unit history.

## What the confirmation records

- The patient's confirmed cancellation request.
- The authorization's status becomes cancelled, with today as its closing date, and its units remaining become zero.
- One release entry with the reason "cancellation" is added to its unit history for the units released.
- A cancelled authorization is never reopened.

## Invocation

The tool is `confirm_outpatient_cancellation_09e1d470`. It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, that is, the patient, or the parent or guardian of a minor patient, confirming in person.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_authorization_id` | the reference number of the authorization the patient is cancelling, as the representative read it out from the patient's referral and authorization record | identifier |
| `units_released` | the units the cancellation releases, in the authorization's own unit of measure, exactly as the representative stated it | whole number, 0 or more |

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `cancellation_request_id` (the reference number of the confirmed cancellation request), `release_entry_id` (the reference number of the release entry), `referral_authorization_id` (the authorization cancelled), `status` (reading "cancelled" once recorded), `closed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `units_released` (the units released).

## Scope

The authorizations this confirmation covers are those counted in visits, hours or rental months: the Specialty Care Referral, the Rehabilitative Therapy Referral, the Durable Medical Equipment Authorization, the Home Health Care Authorization and the Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization.
